==Notes==
*This stance ends as a skill finishes activation, apparently before the activation itself.
** [[Attack skill]]s will benefit from the faster attack speed, but not from the 100% bonus adrenaline.
** [[Barbarous Slice]] will cause bleeding, [[Standing Slash]] and the [["Dance with Death"]] inscription (with an attack skill) will not grant bonus damage, so you are not considered in a stance for related effects.
*Berserker Stance helps quickly build adrenaline for skills such as [[Brawling Headbutt]] and [["On Your Knees!"]], which can in exchange recharge this stance.
